title: AC-JEPA: Anchored Cross-Modal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Visual-to-Symbolic Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.36493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-modal translation requires models to capture shared semantics across modalities while preserving the fine-grained structure required by the target modality. Yet in real-world scientific domains, paired data are often imperfect, while obtaining clean pairs at scale is costly. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) directly optimizes cross-modal translation through categorical token-level supervision, but this objective is sensitive to errors in the target sequences. JEPA offers a complementary representation-space objective, but most existing formulations focus on prediction within a modality rather than translation across modalities. We introduce Anchored Cross-Modal JEPA (AC-JEPA), an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions using paired data. translated_title: AC-JEPA：用于视觉到符号翻译的锚定跨模态联合嵌入预测架构
translated_abstract: 跨模态翻译要求模型既能捕捉跨模态间的共享语义，又能保留目标模态所需的细粒度结构。然而在现实世界的科学领域中，配对数据往往并不完美，而大规模获取干净的配对数据成本高昂。监督微调（SFT）通过分类式的token级别监督直接优化跨模态翻译，但该目标对目标序列中的错误较为敏感。JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）提供了一种互补的表示空间层面的目标，但现有的大多数形式侧重于模态内的预测，而非跨模态的翻译。我们提出了锚定跨模态JEPA（AC-JEPA），这是一个与SFT兼容的即插即用模块，利用配对数据在两个跨模态方向上预测被掩码的中间状态。联合嵌入目标聚焦于可从上下文预测的跨模态结构，而因果SFT路径则保留直接的token级别监督……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AC-JEPA，一种与监督微调兼容的即插即用模块，通过在跨模态两个方向上预测被掩码的中间状态的联合嵌入目标，来利用不完美的配对数据，从而在保留token级监督的同时提升视觉到符号跨模态翻译对目标序列错误的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AC-JEPA, an SFT-compatible plug-in that predicts masked intermediate states in both cross-modal directions via a joint-embedding objective, leveraging imperfect paired data to complement token-level supervision for robust visual-to-symbolic translation.
